column1: # scripts/listening-pack.tsv: the listening pack's renders (checkpoint M2, docs/checkpoints/M2.md says what to listen
# for in each group). One render a line, tab-separated:
# group: the files of one group are loudness-matched together (not a group whose name ends in -raw: its question is
# the loudness) and named <group>-<label>.wav, so they sort side by side.
# quick: 1 for the ten most telling files (--quick). build: under content/builds/. scenario: a path from the checkout's
# root. define (optional): a compile-time define for the simulator (tee-render --define), as Q's TEE_FAST.
# A line whose build is missing (a package not landed yet) is skipped and listed in the pack's README.txt.
